patch_list: Every "watch an ad" offer in Jetpack Joyride pays out instantly — the reward is claimed without playing any video, with no countdown and no network round trip, and the offer stays repeatable. Works offline.
Intercepts all in-app purchases and reports instant success to the game engine.

Stops the full-screen interstitial adverts Jetpack Joyride shows between runs. The game's own "no ad available" path is replayed, so the run continues immediately instead of freezing or waiting on a skipped advert.

Unlocks every event (seasonal worlds, event missions and their pop-ups) by disabling the game's internal "IAP cheat" flag check. When a free-IAP patch forges a purchase the game's receipt validator marks the account as a cheater and locks…

patch_list: Block Ads & Video Commercials - Jetpack Joyride (Experimental)

Free Shopping & Billing Bypass - Jetpack Joyride (Experimental)

⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Keeps Barry's vehicle and gadget shields permanently active in Jetpack Joyride, preventing destruction upon contact with zappers, missiles, and laser fields.
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks all Stash gadgets (Coin Magnet, Gravity Belt, Air Barrys, etc.) and maxes out vehicle coin magnets without spending coins.
